name: hud_layout_base_update_all
description: HudLayoutBase::UpdateAll forwards its delta time to HudUiContainer::UpdateAll.
known_limits: Tier C only; tier S verification is deferred to a HUD layout source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly and decompilation for 0x412be0 validate forwarding the incoming deltaTime argument directly to HudUiContainer::UpdateAll and thiscall stack cleanup for the float argument.
0x4bc900 HudUiContainer::UpdateAll is functionally equivalent under target hud_ui_container_update_all.
The native layout shutdown smoke constructs a layout-as-container with a test child, calls HudLayoutBase::UpdateAll(0.75f), and verifies the child update dispatch receives the exact delta.
